title: The control plane reads rizzstack.attempt/1 states and reports an unknown state explicitly

outcome.summary: orbit-control-plane maps every attempt state it serves through the rizzstack.attempt/1 vocabulary instead of comparing raw launcher strings, keeps its client-side lifecycle columns unchanged, and surfaces a state it does not know as 'unknown' with the raw value preserved. Retry and review guards keep their meaning: only a succeeded (or review) attempt can be reviewed, and an in-flight attempt cannot be retried.
observable_behavior: GET /api/v1/attempts and /api/v1/attempts/<id> report state from the rizzstack.attempt/1 table; a raw state outside it becomes unknown and remote_state keeps the original.
The review guard accepts only succeeded/review and the retry guard refuses an in-flight attempt, unchanged by the mapping.
A mapping is a pure function with a closed table, so an added launcher state is a one-line table change with a test.

interfaces.name: src/control.mjs state mapping
interfaces.notes: Add ATTEMPT_STATES map + map_attempt_state(state) -> {state, remote_state}; use it in the attempt readers and the review/retry guards.

interfaces.name: src/server.mjs attempt routes
interfaces.notes: Serve the mapped state; keep the response shape and the client_state columns.

acceptance_criteria.statement: a known launcher state is reported through the table and an unknown one becomes unknown with remote_state preserved
tests: tests/attempt-states.test.mjs::known states map through the table and an unknown state is reported as unknown

acceptance_criteria.statement: the review guard accepts only succeeded/review and the retry guard refuses an in-flight attempt
tests: tests/attempt-states.test.mjs::the review and retry guards keep their meaning

dependencies: B3 (mojomast/workflow#177, merged 4d22c070 as 1ea44bea) freezes the rizzstack.attempt/1 state vocabulary

RED commit b1295f18af39128b40bc2b020d4f875bb9363185 is test-only: tests/attempt-states.test.mjs fails because an unknown launcher state is served raw instead of unknown, and no client_state is preserved; the review/retry guards pass at source_rev
assumptions: the control plane reads attempt states from its own store and never calls the worker launcher directly
the client lifecycle columns are unchanged; the mapping is presentation plus guard input
